title: 16S-nf pipeline parameters
description: ONT 16S rRNA amplicon microbial community classification: vsearch identity clustering + spoa/racon/medaka consensus + reference/BLAST taxonomy assignment, plus Bray-Curtis/PCoA beta diversity.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV with two columns: sample,fastq.
input.help_text: Each row maps a sample name to a fastq file or glob (e.g. `data/barcode17/*.fastq.gz`). A glob may match multiple part-files -- they're merged into one file per sample before filtering. Glob paths resolve relative to the launch directory, not the samplesheet's own location.

outdir.description: Output directory where results are published.

taxonomy_database.title: Reference database
taxonomy_database.description: Which 16S reference sequences to build the run's BLAST db from.

tax_db_source.help_text: 'silva138' and 'refseq16s' auto-download and cache their reference fasta (under --tax_db_cache) instead of requiring --taxdb: 'silva138' is SILVA 138.1 SSURef restricted to Bacteria/Archaea with sequences converted from RNA to DNA; 'refseq16s' is NCBI's RefSeq targeted-loci 16S export (Bacteria+Archaea). Both need network access from wherever the pipeline runs. --taxdb is ignored unless this is 'custom'.

taxdb.description: 16S reference sequences FASTA. Required when --tax_db_source custom, ignored otherwise.
taxdb.help_text: A BLAST db is (re)built from this file at the start of every run, so the reference set can be updated without a separate makeblastdb step.

tax_db_cache.description: Where auto-downloaded reference databases are cached between runs.
tax_db_cache.help_text: Only relevant for --tax_db_source silva138/refseq16s; each is downloaded once and reused from here on subsequent runs. Irrelevant for --tax_db_source custom.

primer_trimming.title: Primer trimming
primer_trimming.description: cutadapt primer trimming -- skipped entirely if left unset.

fwd_primer.help_text: IUPAC nucleotide codes only (ACGTU + ambiguity codes WSMKRYBDHVN). Case-insensitive. e.g. 27F (AGAGTTTGATCMTGGCTCAG) for full-length 16S.

rev_primer.help_text: IUPAC nucleotide codes only (ACGTU + ambiguity codes WSMKRYBDHVN). Case-insensitive. e.g. 1492R (TACGGYTACCTTGTTACGACTT) for full-length 16S.

min_len.help_text: Default sized for full-length 16S (~1.2-1.8kb via 27F/1492R). Narrow this for a single V-region amplicon instead.

enable_read_stats.description: Summarize read length and Q-score before vs. after filtering.
enable_read_stats.help_text: Writes read_qc_summary.html, read_stats.tsv and read_length_qscore_hist.tsv to final_report/. Purely informational -- nothing downstream depends on it.

clustering.title: Clustering
clustering.description: vsearch de novo identity clustering, plus a second vsearch pass that merges near-identical cluster consensus sequences.

cluster_id.description: vsearch identity threshold (fraction identity to the cluster centroid).
cluster_id.help_text: Tune per amplicon/primer set and basecaller accuracy -- too loose merges distinct organisms into one cluster, too strict splits one organism's reads (or its multiple rRNA operon copies) into several small clusters that fall under min_cluster and are dropped.

min_cluster.description: Minimum reads in a read-level cluster required to attempt consensus.
min_cluster.help_text: A compute and consensus-quality floor, not a statement about which taxa are real: a consensus from only a few reads is barely better than one read, and every surviving cluster costs several downstream tasks. Keep it low so fragments of one organism can still be merged (merge_id); judge how well-supported a taxon is with min_abundance / min_rel_abundance instead.

merge_id.description: Identity at which per-cluster consensus sequences are merged (second vsearch pass); 0 skips the merge.
merge_id.help_text: The read-level pass must run loose enough for raw ONT error, which can split one organism into several clusters. Consensus sequences are far more accurate, so near-identical ones are folded back together here, keeping the largest cluster's consensus and summing the read counts. Set lower to merge more aggressively, higher (or 0) to keep close species/variants apart. Multi-copy rRNA operons within one genome can differ slightly, so re-tune for your amplicon region.

enable_medaka.description: Use the medaka-polished consensus instead of the racon consensus downstream.
enable_medaka.help_text: Off by default: the racon consensus is used directly as the final consensus for BLAST and reporting. When enabled, MEDAKA runs as an additional ONT-specific polishing step and its output replaces the racon consensus everywhere downstream.

taxonomy_assignment.title: Taxonomy assignment
taxonomy_assignment.description: BLAST-based taxonomy assignment, confidence and abundance flagging.

min_pident.description: BLAST %identity threshold for a confident call.
min_pident.help_text: Hits below this identity are flagged low_identity rather than dropped, and routed to consensus_by_confidence/low_confidence/ instead of confident/. Clusters with no BLAST hit at all are flagged no_hit. Also determines which clusters count as an identified taxon for the rarefaction curve and PCoA (flagged clusters are excluded from both).

min_abundance.description: Merged clusters with fewer reads than this get low_abundance = true.
min_abundance.help_text: Applied to the merged cluster_size (reads from every cluster folded into it by merge_id). Flag-only: the cluster is still BLASTed and reported, with low_abundance = true in its own column of the abundance table (flag_reason is unaffected). Does not affect the consensus_by_confidence folders. 0 disables.

min_rel_abundance.description: Merged clusters holding a smaller fraction of their sample's clustered reads than this get low_abundance = true.
min_rel_abundance.help_text: The depth-independent counterpart of min_abundance: 0.001 marks anything under 0.1% of the sample's clustered reads, however many reads the barcode has. A cluster is marked if it fails either cutoff. 0 disables.

beta_diversity.title: Beta diversity (PCoA)
beta_diversity.description: Optional per-sample metadata for coloring the PCoA plot -- doesn't affect the pipeline's classification steps at all.

metadata.description: Optional CSV: sample,<any metadata columns> (e.g. sample,group,site).
metadata.help_text: Joined onto the PCoA coordinates by sample. Left blank, the PCoA still runs (Bray-Curtis + classical PCoA across samples), just without anything to color the points by.

container_images.title: Container images
container_images.description: Where each tool's container image is pulled from.

container_registry.description: Registry for the biocontainers images (blast, chopper, cutadapt, minimap2, pandas, racon, spoa, vsearch).
container_registry.help_text: The google_batch profile points this at the project's own Artifact Registry mirror (see scripts/mirror_images.sh) so Batch VMs don't pull from quay.io; pass --container_registry quay.io to pull from upstream instead. The mirror keeps each image's upstream path, so only the host changes.

dockerhub_registry.description: Registry for the Docker Hub images (medaka, and ubuntu for the reference downloads and on Batch).
dockerhub_registry.help_text: Same idea as container_registry, for images that come from Docker Hub.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options, typically left at their defaults.

help.description: Display the help message and exit.

tracedir.description: Directory for the Nextflow timeline/report/trace files.
